newsitem.title: CHINA: Russia, China defence ministers eye cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Russia, China defence ministers eye cooperation.

text.p: Russian Defence Minister Igor Rodionov is to discuss military cooperation with his Chinese counterpart, Chi Haotian, during a meeting in Beijing on Monday, a spokesman for the Russian embassy said.

Rodionov arrived on Sunday for a five-day visit and would also meet China's Communist Party boss and military commander-in-chief, Jiang Zemin, and Liu Huaqing, a vice-chairman of the Central Military Commission, the spokesman said.
Military cooperation to be discussed between the defence ministers would include an exchange of visits, but would not involve technical cooperation, the spokesman said.
The discussions would not touch on arms sales and no documents would be signed during the trip, the spokesman said.
Rodionov would visit military sites and cultural monuments before leaving on Friday.
The visit is the latest sign of warming relations between the two countries, coming just prior to a scheduled visit by Jiang to Moscow from April 22-26.
